slides.head: 260,000 AI fakes. One label.
slides.body: Sony Music has asked platforms to remove more than 260,000 AI tracks that impersonate its artists.

slides.head: The number nearly doubled.
slides.body: About 135,000 at the end of March. The fakes copy Harry Styles, Adele and Michael Jackson.

slides.head: 18 months in prison.
slides.body: A North Carolina man was sentenced for an AI-song streaming scheme that earned over $8 million in royalties.

slides.head: The U.S. Copyright Office is looking in.
slides.body: A new inquiry into streaming fraud. Public comments are due Nov. 23.

slides.head: Suno is going live.
slides.body: The AI music company hired a Ticketmaster executive to run its live arm, including Songkick.

slides.head: The line is getting clear.
slides.body: Making music with AI is fine. Faking an artist, or faking the streams, is not.
